title: Observe fleet for a week after opum-workflow 0.4.0 restart
summary: Per opum-agent, once the fleet is actually running opum-workflow 0.4.0: observe for a week that (1) OMARK-10/OPAG-62's fix holds -- no orchestrator idle message relayed as a worker needs-input alert in any repo, and (2) OMARK-18/OPAG-63's skill amendment holds -- no direct commit to dev in any fleet repository. These are OMARK-10's own acceptance criterion 2 and part of OPAG-63's acceptance criteria, both of which needed post-release observation and couldn't be checked at merge time. OMARK-10 is already archived (Done/completed), so this is filed separately rather than reopening it -- quest task edit refuses a completed task, same gap OMARK-19 recorded for OMARK-13. CORRECTED 2026-09-08 (opum-agent): the observation week begins on the day the fleet actually lands on 0.4.0, not on the date this task was filed -- see the implementation note for why the first restart did not land it.
implementationNotes: Correction (opum-agent, 2026-09-08): the 2026-09-08 restart did NOT land opum-workflow 0.4.0. All eight fleet sessions, including this one, came back up still running 0.3.2 -- confirmed by a fleet-wide roll-call opum-agent ran after the restart (opum-marketplace's own reply: opum-workflow 0.3.2 / opum-lore 0.4.4 / opum-quest 0.3.4, matching the orchestrator's own numbers exactly). Cause: each consumer's local 'opum' marketplace clone (~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/opum) is a separate cache with its own refresh step; a session restart re-reads that cache rather than refreshing it, and nothing in the restart path reports that the cache is behind. The clone was pinned at fdff2f9 (2026-09-06T02:16:46Z), predating both this repo's v0.5.0 federated-pin bump (OMARK-20) and the 0.4.0 opum-workflow bump. Upstream dev was never wrong -- verified directly from this repo with HEAD == origin/dev: plugin.json declares 0.4.0, marketplace.json pins opum-lore and opum-quest at v0.5.0 both. opum-agent has since refreshed the clone (now at e30751d, this repo's OMARK-21-filing commit) and bumped all three plugins to 0.4.0/0.5.0/0.5.0 at user scope; the CLI reports 'Restart to apply changes', so a second fleet restart is pending. Do not start the observation week until that second restart lands -- observing the still-running 0.3.2 build would measure a build that still has the notify-orchestrator misattribution OMARK-10 fixed and predates the opum-sdlc tracker-chore Deliver-path text OMARK-18 added, so a quiet week against it would be a false negative, not a pass.
